body: Named-root and committed-input behavior introduced by the recorded Nov6 ee2f21c6 rollout (not a statement of today's installed build): a registered launcher run matching two named-root entries for the same worktree in one session gets a loud refusal naming both entries, rather than a silent unbind (w-9200b26b7cb1). The rev5 committed-input reader refuses incomplete Git reads, including Git stderr on exit0, and pins core.longpaths=true/core.safecrlf=false per invocation on Windows (w-43ba19db0403). Own-current-binding release409 names the supported termal_name_source_root clear form (w-bc25de6bbe39). General practice: one live claim per named worktree; use the supported owner clear before reassigning it. Exact current APIs/contracts and task bindings decide applicability; historical host hashes and DL560 deployment state remain in revision1 and do not prove current runtime identity. No clear, release, rename, check, configuration or rollout is authorized by this memory.
